title: •Black 3
caption: •Black 3 (V)
game_text: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. When this starship is targeted by Tallon Roll, “Rebel” in its game text may be treated as “{independent}” or “{icon:republic}”. While DS-61-3 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.
lore: TIE/ln fighter of pilot DS-61-3. Stylized image of Corellian slice-hound painted on inner hatch.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner STARFIGHTER: TIE/ln (lower-case 'ln' as printed). Stats POWER 1 / MANEUVER 3 / NO HYPERDRIVE (label only); deploy 1 / forfeit 3. No column icons, no scomp ring on the slip. INLINE ICONS inside curly quotes: first a blue square tile with a spoked wheel = Independent starship icon (matches inline-independent.png) → {independent}; second a lavender square tile with a silver Republic emblem → {icon:republic} (square tile, not the round crest — same as vs12/08; the renderer maps {icon:republic} to the round crest and may need a square tile). GEMP's Virtual Block 1 text confirms '[Independent Starship]' or '[Republic]'. The wiki stub reads them as “Imperial” or “Cloud City” — WRONG, stub should be corrected. Lore matches the scan. Only a 350 px scan; copyright 1995 (Premiere) by set, not legible. Modern: V10-D-black3.gif (745 px) is the PC's later Virtual Set 10 Black 3 (V) (different text) — art backport only; VB1 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
